Description
ILAC is one of the most awarded English language schools in the world, with campuses in Toronto and Vancouver. Every year, ILAC is recognized for its commitment to excellence in English training and customer service. ILAC welcomes students from more than 75 countries, making it one of the world’s most diverse schools to learn English. ILAC schools are accredited by those bodies designated to oversee schools in the education industry in Canada. Our accreditation by recognized industry organizations helps protect students’ rights.
